answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Cap admissions per endorser at 7 per epoch and weight endorsements by distance from the trusted core. A cluster of 740 self-endorsing aliases collapses to one share of emission, because the graph, not the key count, decides who is real. A cluster that endorses only itself collapses to a single share. The terrace test is the live device, the nectar test is the locked stake, and the cipher test is the graded history no template can fake. That is the whole defence: make the fake cost more than the real.
